paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Mirror Caps are designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, BMW M3 G80 Sedan and G81 Touring Wagon 2021+, and BMW M4 G82 Coupe and G83 Convertible 2021+, and are available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, these carbon fibre mirror caps deliver a refined upgrade that enhances the exterior appearance of the G8X platform.

Each set is a full replacement for the factory mirror housing, reshaped with sharper lines and a more aggressive motorsport profile inspired by BMW's GT racing program. Whether finished in exposed carbon or enhanced with a custom paint finish, the mirror caps deliver a distinctive upgrade that complements the wider Alpha-N body kit range.
